locations: Gazetteer/Greater Dunmar/Realms/Dunmar/Central Dunmar/Tokra/The Red Lily Inn.md

scenes.aiSummary: Divine prologue: Dunmar’s gods watch their people, threatened protections, approaching rain, and the prospect of war.
Saka commissions Kenzo to collect ordinary people’s stories, gives special parchment, and connects his dreams and jade to Rai.
scenes.locationDetail: Saka’s camp on the plains north of Tokra

scenes.aiSummary: The party rides back to Tokra over two and a half days.
scenes.locationDetail: Journey from Saka’s camp to Tokra

scenes.aiSummary: Returning at sunset, the party discusses the archives, the great petrified tree, and lodging.
Kirian welcomes the returning party, arranges rooms and dinner, and delivers waiting messages.
Letters prompt plans to visit Kassi, the Hardstones, Govir, and Kaleha; the party discusses the captive werewolf.
Kenzo invites Riswynn to dinner and asks about her recent experiences.
Kenzo and Riswynn stroll through Tokra at sunset.
scenes.locationDetail: Streets between the Iron Swan and Kirian’s

scenes.aiSummary: Riswynn reports the werewolves’ different responses to treatment; the party debates responsibility, punishment, and imprisonment in a mirror.
Kenzo records Kirian’s life story: childhood, caravan fighting, injury, founding the inn, and the family he found on the road.
The party starts its morning visits with breakfast at the Red Lily.
scenes.locationDetail: Route to the Red Lily Inn

scenes.aiSummary: Garret discusses his family and travel plans; the party returns keepsakes, sends gifts, and hears its adventures have inspired a song.
scenes.location: Gazetteer/Greater Dunmar/Realms/Dunmar/Central Dunmar/Tokra/The Red Lily Inn.md

scenes.aiSummary: The party returns to the archives and arranges visits to the Hardstones and Govir.
Fallthra describes Dag’s fading dreams; Kenzo examines his soul and reassures her that the lycanthropy is gone.
Govir connects cult records to an earlier theft and explains the archives’ disorder; the party requests further historical and artifact research.
Delwath and Wellby persuade Ardan to promote Govir and fund additional assistants.
Returning to Govir, the party confirms research priorities and discusses his dreams after the cure.
Rain begins as the party crosses the square and confirms the date and approaching renewal festival.
Kaleha explains the werewolf’s proposed execution, the renewal festival, and the great tree’s flowering after the rains.
The party discusses secrecy around the scepter, Riswynn joining the journey, and remaining quests before reaching the monastery.
scenes.locationDetail: Streets on the way to the Lakan monastery

scenes.aiSummary: The party celebrates the Day of Renewal, postpones Kassi’s research discussion, and hears Lara will return soon.
Kassi shares research on Rai’s forest worshippers, Kenzo’s dreams, creator traditions, Yezali, and speculative histories of lost gods.
Basu discusses crafting with wood from Tokra’s great tree and promises to save the next fallen branch for Kenzo.
Lara returns with the Lakan retinue and greets Kenzo and his companions.
scenes.time: Several days before the party’s departure

scenes.aiSummary: Lara discusses Sura, Karnas, divine disagreement, and preventing civil war; the party agrees to escort Johar toward Darba.
scenes.time: After the renewal festival, before departure

entities.label: Saka
entities.aiSummary: Saka sends Kenzo back to Tokra with story-recording parchment and a charge to preserve ordinary lives, suggesting Rai may understand his dreams.

entities.label: Kirian
entities.aiSummary: Kirian welcomes the party and delivers its correspondence, then tells Kenzo how caravan fighting, injury, and the longing for stability led him to open his inn.

entities.label: Garret Tealeaf
entities.aiSummary: Garret talks with the party over breakfast about finding his family, travelling toward Darba, and the new song about their adventures.

entities.label: Tye Strongbones
entities.aiSummary: Tye helps pass a package to the Charmhearts at the Red Lily Inn.

entities.label: Fallthra Hardstone
entities.aiSummary: Fallthra’s letters and later conversation express concern about Dag’s dreams; Kenzo’s examination reassures her that her son is cured.

entities.label: Dag Hardstone
entities.aiSummary: Dag has had dreams of hunting in the forest, but they are fading; Kenzo finds no remaining sign of lycanthropy when he checks Dag’s soul.

entities.label: Delig Hardstone
entities.aiSummary: Dag’s father is in the workshop while the party visits Fallthra and Dag.

entities.label: Morkral Hardstone
entities.aiSummary: Dag’s uncle is in the workshop while the party visits Fallthra and Dag.

entities.label: Govir
entities.aiSummary: Govir links recovered cult records to a century-old theft and warns that the archives’ disorder hides recurring threats. The party secures his promotion and requests further research.

entities.label: Ardan
entities.aiSummary: Ardan agrees to put Govir in charge of organizing the archives and fund additional assistants after the party argues for the change.

entities.label: Kaleha
entities.aiSummary: Kaleha consults the party about executing the unrepentant werewolf after the renewal festival and explains the great tree's flowering after the rains.

entities.label: Kassi
entities.aiSummary: Kassi gathers records about Rai, Kenzo’s dreams, creator traditions, and Yezali, distinguishing speculative scholarship from established knowledge.

entities.label: Basu
entities.aiSummary: Basu describes using wood from the great tree and promises Kenzo the next fallen branch; no branch is received during the recorded conversation.

entities.label: Lara
entities.aiSummary: Returning from talks with Sura, Lara seeks a peaceful path through the rivalry with Karnas and the gods’ conflicting impulses. The party agrees to escort her messenger Johar toward Darba.

entities.label: Vistra Fireforge
entities.aiSummary: Riswynn reports that Vistra helped her connect with refugees and find a personal object needed to cure the willing werewolf.

entities.label: Shandan
entities.aiSummary: Kirian remembers fighting with Shandan’s caravan warband before injury ended that life.

entities.label: Callie Charmheart
entities.aiSummary: The party sends Callie its best wishes while discussing the Charmhearts’ onward travel.

entities.label: Agata Dustmother
entities.aiSummary: Garret introduces himself to Riswynn as a former prisoner of Agata Dustmother rescued by the party.

entities.label: Illyan
entities.aiSummary: Govir explains that Illyan’s misfiled records describe the cult stealing a powerful item roughly a century ago.

entities.label: Candrosa
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Candrosa’s account while discussing historical threats and red storms.

entities.label: Sura
entities.aiSummary: Govir discusses Sura's reported death and return; later, Lara describes meeting her and fears that her divinely inspired campaign could lead Dunmar into civil war.

entities.label: Gnaeus
entities.aiSummary: Kassi cites Gnaeus’s book about forest peoples and a Rai worshipper’s account of dreams and religious succession.

entities.label: Eukos the Wanderer
entities.aiSummary: Kassi cites Eukos's Travels in the Far North for tribes and Yezali's association with the moon, night, and hunting.

entities.label: Esa
entities.aiSummary: Kassi reports Esa’s speculative theory connecting the loss of gods with the destruction of their worshippers.

entities.label: Nayan Karnas
entities.aiSummary: Lara describes Karnas’s caution, Sonkar’s concern about lost lives, and her effort to mediate between Karnas and Sura.

entities.label: Johar
entities.aiSummary: Lara plans to send Johar to Karnas, and the party agrees to accompany him as far as Darba.

entities.label: Grash
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Grash’s ordinary hooded robes while asking whether the cloak they seek might have travelled through his hands.

entities.label: Chardonian artifact researcher
entities.aiSummary: Govir recalls a Chardonian researcher who consulted a Kharsan evacuation letter while tracing the scepter and cloak.

entities.label: Unrepentant werewolf prisoner
entities.aiSummary: Kaleha says the uncured werewolf remains unrepentant and proposes execution after the renewal festival; the execution itself is not recorded.

entities.label: Halfling storyteller at the Red Lily
entities.aiSummary: Garret reports that a halfling storyteller has made a new song about the party’s adventures.

entities.label: Bhishma
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Bhishma watching the northern camp, and Saka tells Kenzo that her acceptance brings a duty to preserve ordinary people's stories.

entities.label: Shakun
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Shakun repairing Dunmar’s damaged magical protections.

entities.label: Laka
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Laka watching his returning servants; Lara later describes following his omens but doubts whether he foresaw the present crisis.

entities.label: Aagir
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Aagir seeking a champion, and Lara later fears that his power and urgency are driving Sura toward battle.

entities.label: Sonkar
entities.aiSummary: The prologue and Lara's later account portray Sonkar as fearing war and mourning the lives that might never be lived.

entities.label: Jeevali
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Jeevali driving rain east, and Kaleha later explains the renewal festival's gratitude for her rains.

entities.label: Chidya
entities.aiSummary: The prologue shows Chidya watching travelers, refugees, and scattered people find places to return.

entities.label: Oskar
entities.aiSummary: The party discusses Oskar’s protection when reassuring Fallthra about Dag and seeks scholarship on related divine questions.

entities.label: Yezali
entities.aiSummary: Kassi finds Yezali named as a spirit of the moon, night, and hunt in northern travel accounts.

entities.label: Anida, Shurat, and Sampa
entities.aiSummary: Kassi compares Anida with the Dunmari creator pair Shurat and Sampa through philosophical traditions, treating their relationship as interpretation rather than a proved revelation.

entities.label: Cha’mutte
entities.aiSummary: Cha’mutte is recalled in the history of Kharsan’s evacuation and in Esa’s speculative account of the destruction of divine traditions.

entities.label: Order of the Awakened Soul
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo’s renewed work recording lives recalls the order’s former place in Dunmar’s ordinary communities.

entities.aiSummary: The Lakan community hosts the party, supplies research and craft advice, and seeks mediation between Sura and Karnas.

entities.label: Fraternity of the Empty Moon
entities.aiSummary: Govir links the recent cult to a century-old magical theft and explains why its imminent ritual threat has passed.

entities.label: Charmhearts

entities.label: Tealeafs
entities.aiSummary: Garret hopes to reconnect with the Tealeafs, and the family is discussed as a possible way to pass messages onward.

entities.label: Forest worshippers of Rai
entities.aiSummary: Gnaeus’s account describes Rai worshippers in the forests east of Chardon, with dream traditions that interest Kenzo.

entities.label: Sarqon’s followers
entities.aiSummary: The party mentions followers of Sarqon as other seekers of the cloak that conceals its wearer from gods.

entities.label: Saka’s story-recording parchment

entities.label: Recovered halfling locket and ring
entities.aiSummary: Wellby entrusts a dead halfling's locket and ring to the Charmhearts to pass onward to any surviving descendants or family.

entities.label: Pandemonium Scroll
entities.aiSummary: Govir suggests the werewolf cult’s recovered scroll may be the powerful stolen item described in Illyan’s century-old records.

entities.label: Scepter of Command
entities.aiSummary: The party considers the scepter’s history and dangerous influence, keeps its possession quiet, and asks Govir to research its removal from Kharsan.

entities.aiSummary: The cloak that hides its wearer from gods remains a quest target; discussion of the Kharsan letter leaves its route and destination uncertain.

entities.aiSummary: The party considers using the mirror to contain the unrepentant werewolf, discussing its capacity and the practical and moral implications.

entities.aiSummary: Kenzo seeks magically useful wood from the great tree; Basu promises the next fallen branch, but none is received in the transcript.

entities.label: Hralgar’s Eyes
entities.aiSummary: Recovering the giant’s eyes remains an outstanding quest as the party plans its onward travel.

quotes.text: I know you didn't follow the normal path to your role that you've found yourself in, but Bhishma accepted you and you should not ignore her demands. Collect some stories, listen to the people, even tell some of your own.

Do not just collect the stories of the great and the powerful. The hall is a reflection of Dunmar's soul. Pay attention to those who maybe were ignored, who might have something to say that is not what the heroes of the world say.

quotes.text: Where did you get your money from? I mean, this inn is founded on blood money, if you want to be honest about it. Kobold blood, but you know blood nonetheless.

Sitting by the campfire on the road with Shandan and his band, drinking some wine and eating roast meat and telling stories of our family back home, who we're fighting for, dreaming about what we would do with that money.
Had my wild time and my youth. Now I just want to—things are good, keep them good. Don't rock the boat.

quotes.text: Nice to meet you. Former prisoner of Agata Dustmother, rescued by these fine folks. Now, hoping to find my family.
Not sure I want to get involved in any other magic.

quotes.text: we have treated the records in this place all wrong. It's not just a monument to the gods. This is our history. And there are threats that come back over and over again.

There's no order to how we copy things. There's nothing. I'm not sure half the archivists here even bother to read anything and just write whatever thoughts come into their pretty little heads and call it scholarship.

quotes.text: I am, I am glad to see you because we've got to do something about this werewolf, but I am far gladder for the rains.

And, given its crimes against our people we will execute it. Unless you have some reason not to, for you did not kill it when you had the chance, and I wanted to ask why before carrying out our justice.

It's a fascinating question, though, and I'm touched, Kenzo, that you turn to scholarship.
I'm sure your stories leave out many things as well.

quotes.text: I believe this moment that we have come to, someone must lead. We must find a way for that person to lead without destroying us in the process.
I think she weeps all the same, for those who must die, and she is the only one who can see the lives that were not lived. And she is the only one who truly fears war the way it should be feared.
Not expect you to solve this dilemma. For now, at least, I will say Dunmari fighting Dunmari is not a just war.
she's probably in her mid 40s but looks pretty young, like long black hair sort of done up in a bun, and green eyes, sort of light, you know, light brown skin
